title: Error estimation for numerical approximations of ODEs via composition techniques. Part II: BDF methods
summary: Integration of Ordinary Differential Equations (ODEs) using Backward Difference formula (BDF) methods with p backward steps achieves order p accuracy if specific conditions are met. This work extends the composition technique with complex coefficients to the implicit BDF schemes, increasing the approximation order by one without additional backward points. The imaginary part of the composed flow provides an error estimate of order p + 1.
